```python
import math

# Calculate 34 factorial
factorial_34 = math.factorial(34)

# Convert to string to get the digits
digits_str = str(factorial_34)

# Sum all the decimal digits
digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in digits_str)

print(f"34! = {factorial_34}")
print(f"Sum of digits: {digit_sum}")
print(f"ANSWER: {digit_sum}")
```

The code calculates 34! (which equals 295,232,799,039,604,140,847,618,609,643,520,000,000), then sums all of its decimal digits to get the answer.
